name: product-driven-development
description: Curated product memory with bounded, read-only Codex, Claude, and Grok session evidence fallback and no lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Curated product memory with exact session evidence
interface.longDescription: Bundles the Product Driven Development skill, note templates, and an on-demand read-only helper for exact Codex, Claude, and Grok session evidence. Invoke $product-driven-development or ask naturally. The plugin ships no lifecycle hook, daemon, database, automatic session binding, or native slash command.
defaultPrompt: Use $product-driven-development to list my products and their active work.
Use $product-driven-development to answer from curated product knowledge and verify a named Codex, Claude, or Grok session only when evidence fallback is required.
